title: Mathematical Notes
text:
Notes and documents
Add notes as separate .qmd files and link them here. Quarto supports LaTeX-style mathematics, for example,
\[
D : \Gamma(S) \longrightarrow \Gamma(S),
\]
where (D) denotes a Dirac operator acting on sections of a spinor bundle (S).
You can also write inline mathematics, such as ((4) (2)(2)).

How to add a note

Create a new file, for example dirac-operator.qmd.
Add a title and write your text in Markdown with LaTeX mathematics.
Render the site with quarto render.
Add a link to the note on this page.

Welcome to my academic websitee. I am a mathematician interested in geometry, analysis, and the interaction between geometric structures and differential operators.


I am currently pursuing a master’s degree in Mathematical Sciences at the Institute of Mathematics, National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), in Cuernavaca.
My research focuses on the Dirac operator and spectral asymmetry on spherical three-manifolds. More broadly, I am interested in differential geometry, spin geometry, spectral theory, topology, and representation theory.

title: Research
text:
Current research

Spectral asymmetry of the Dirac operator on spherical 3-manifolds
My master’s research concerns the spectral asymmetry of the Dirac operator on spherical three-manifolds. The project studies Dirac spectra on quotients of the three-sphere by finite groups acting freely and explores how group actions and spin structures influence spectral data.
Topics connected with this work include:

Dirac operators and spinor bundles
Spin structures on spherical space forms
Finite group actions and representation theory
Eta invariants and spectral asymmetry

title: Research
text:
Research interests
I am also interested in differential topology, Clifford algebras, representation theory, and geometric constructions of Dirac-type operators.
